events.title: New Demo Update: Co-op Mode
events.summary: Co-op Mode Added: You can now play with a friend! The game supports 2-player online co-op. You can either generate an Invite Code by clicking the “Invite Friend” button, or directly invite players from your Steam Friends list. As this is a new feature, you might encounter some bugs or issues during multiplayer sessions. Custom Difficulty Settings Added: We’ve added new difficulty settings! events.title: Demo is now live!
events.summary: The demo offers about 1 hour of gameplay and concludes after surviving for 3 in-game days. Aside from that, there are no other restrictions. We hope you enjoy the experience! If you encounter any issues, please feel free to leave your feedback in the community.

events.title: Playtest Reopened!
events.summary: As known issues are being fixed one by one, I’ve reopened the Playtest. I hope everyone will actively participate! .Thank you all for your support!

events.title: Playtest Paused for Fixes, Back Soon!
events.summary: Thank you for your anticipation. We are temporarily closing the Playtest due to a number of outstanding issues. Please wait a little while;it will reopen once the problems are resolved!

events.title: Playtest access will be sent out gradually.
events.summary: I am truly grateful to everyone willing to playtest my game. After a week of hard work, I’ve finally got the playtest build fixed up to a state where it runs smoothly.I will be approving playtest requests gradually from here on out. If you encounter any issues in the game, please feel free to discuss them in the community or leave a review. I will carefully consider all of your valuable feedback.

events.title: Thank you for your interest! Playtest keys will be sent soon!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We are super excited to see over 100 playtest applications come in so quickly!To make sure you get the best possible experience, we’re putting the final touches on the Demo and squashing some bugs. We just need a bit more time to get it right.Keep in mind that this playtest is primarily for testing the core gameplay loop.
